purpose: Bilko is a host platform (bilko.run) providing shared auth, credits, component kit, and brand chrome to a growing ecosystem of independently-built sibling apps and a shrinking set of in-repo React tools.
what: Bilko (`StanislavBG/bilko-run`) is the **host**, not a product — each app under `~/Projects/` is its own repo with its own Claude session, registered into `src/data/standalone-projects.json` and served either as a `react-route` (in-bundle) or `static-path` (dropped into `public/projects/<slug>/`) app per the **static-path contract** in `docs/host-contract.md`.

All 9 original AI tools have been extracted to sibling repos; the host repo now ships only brand chrome (`Layout`, `HomePage`, `ProjectsPage`, `BlogPage`, `PricingPage`, `AdminPage`). Eight of those siblings still keep their Gemini-backed scoring endpoint in `server/routes/tools/<slug>.ts` (the **gateway pattern**) — same-origin calls via Clerk JWT, no CORS.

Stack is TypeScript throughout: React 18 + Vite 6 + Tailwind v4 frontend, Fastify 5 + Turso/libSQL backend, Clerk auth, Stripe credits, Gemini AI. Deploys from `origin`/`main` on Render — **never** the diverged `content-grade` remote.

An active Epic (`Hosting Platform Review`, discussion) is reviewing Bilko's capabilities/limitations to support the in-development **Session-Manager-Integration-Agent**, and recent git history shows heavy `session-manager` sibling activity (web-remote relay, marketing/checkout page, Stripe product) plus an Academy 15-lesson curriculum republish.

scope.text: Bilko repo is definitively `StanislavBG/bilko-run`; `content-grade` remote is a separate, unrelated project — never push Bilko there
New apps default to `static-path` (own sibling repo); `react-route` only for rare cases needing to live in-bundle — trend is fully away from in-repo apps
All 9 original AI tools extracted to sibling repos; host repo now ships brand chrome only, though 8 tools still route scoring calls back through host server endpoints (gateway pattern)
Hosting Platform Review epic opened to audit Bilko's capabilities/limitations and expand docs for the in-development Session-Manager-Integration-Agent
Session Manager shipped a dedicated marketing/checkout landing page and one-time Stripe product, plus web-remote relay fixes (auto-refresh on pairing, pty-write error surfacing)

conventions: Never propose solutions — implement them directly
Each tool/app is independent — no cross-dependencies between them in frontend or backend
All SQL via parameterized statements through db helpers — never string interpolation
Static-path app bugs are fixed in the owning sibling repo, never in the published `public/projects/<slug>/` copy
New npm packages follow `docs/publishing-contract.md` (MIT LICENSE on disk, `--provenance`, Changesets CHANGELOG)
